corpus.text: Paid time off requests must be submitted to the employee's supervisor at least 10 calendar days before the requested start date. The supervisor approves requests based on team coverage.
Closed customer records must be retained for seven years after account closure. The records manager reviews the archive every year and documents approved destruction.
Employees must submit business expense claims with itemized receipts within 30 calendar days of purchase. A manager must approve the claim before Finance issues reimbursement.
Account passwords must contain at least 14 characters. Employees must change a password immediately if they believe it has been exposed and must use multi-factor authentication.
When employment ends, employees must return company laptops, badges, and other equipment to IT within five business days of their final working day.
Business air travel must be booked in economy class. Hotel costs may not exceed 220 dollars per night before taxes unless a director approves an exception.
Employees must report a suspected security incident to the security team within one hour of discovery. Do not delete messages or files that may be relevant to the investigation.
Eligible employees may take up to 12 weeks of parental leave after the birth or adoption of a child. Employees should notify Human Resources at least 30 days before leave when practicable.
The main office is open from 8 a.m. until 6 p.m. Monday through Friday. The kitchen is cleaned by Facilities each evening.
A manager may approve up to 1,500 dollars per employee each year for job-related courses and certifications. Reimbursement requires proof of successful completion.
Employees who cannot work because of illness should notify their supervisor before 9 a.m. A medical note is required after three consecutive workdays of absence.
Access to confidential files must be limited to employees whose current job duties require it. Managers must review team access permissions every quarter.
